get_secret: retrieve secrets from os.environ, oidc providers, or secret manager with fallback support
get_secret_str: get a secret value as a string from the secret manager or environment variables
get_secret_bool: get a secret value as a boolean from the secret manager or environment variables
oidc_cache: cache OIDC tokens from providers like google, github, and azure with configurable TTL
str_to_bool: convert a string value to boolean returning true, false, or None for unrecognized values
